scope: Pinned original source inspection only. No native execution, seccomp activation, policy loading or application acceptance. HTTPS source retrieval is not signed host/GSI equivalence.

observations.finding: SpecializeCommon prepares inheritable/bounding caps, storage/native-bridge prerequisites, groups/rlimits, gid; installs seccomp while privileged before uid drop, later sets capabilities and original seapp context. Explicit comment rejects NNP alternative because of SELinux transition. No executed proof.

Cached security_getenforce selects whether app/system and UID/GID seccomp filters run. Permissive branch returns without installing these filters; not an acceptable isolation demonstration. Failure/error edge still requires full call-path review.

Service path enters namespaces, publishes descriptors, waits for cgroup activation, applies profiles, credentials/context/caps, then exec. setexeccon is explicit only for nonempty seclabel. Functions examined do not themselves establish NNP; absence in selected files is not a whole-system absence proof.

Original non-console service setup replaces stdio via /dev/null or kmsg_debug, creates process group, applies rlimits, primary/supplemental groups, uid and priority. Device labels, capabilities and cgroup ordering are prerequisites, not fixed by process2 grants.

decision.selected: No placement change yet. Keep current NNP controls and selected-prefix model experimental. Evaluate coherent cohort alternatives before implementation.

alternatives.requires: Enumerate original exec/dyntransition paths, process2/bounds/constraints and caps retained across exec, including app specialization. Six current manager process2 denials unresolved; prefix permissions insufficient.

alternatives.mode: Trusted original cohort without inherited NNP, tighten application boundary later
alternatives.requires: Demonstrate minimal credentials/capabilities and mount/device/cgroup containment, original seccomp/seapp transitions, host protection and recovery. Would change established security design; not implemented or implicitly authorized.

decision.not_equivalent: NNP, SELinux enforcing, UID/caps, seccomp and namespaces have distinct contracts; one cannot stand in for another.

next: Trace original zygote app seapp selection and libseccomp installation plus init manager capability/RC requirements. Build a whole-cohort identity/FD/device/cgroup transition inventory before another policy variant. Then S0–S2 and separately authorized live MAC; Markor nine stages remain untested.
limitations: Original comment explains design intent, not proof that every current kernel path fails under NNP. Reference kernel process2 model remains separate.
No filters or contexts have been assigned, no services available, no Markor launch.
No ARM translation, external-service or DRM compatibility result.
